ios.desc: This app sees what song you are playing in Apple Music and offers links to the Wikipedia entries for the Song, Artist, and Album (if they exist and can be found). People who want to know more about the music they're listening to can easily see what has been posted to Wikipedia about it. It does not work for Apple Music Radio stations though, but does work for playlists from Apple.

show_hn.title: Show HN: A simple iOS app to go from music to Wikipedia

quotes.text: I am embarrassed to show this here, as it is trivial, but I published an app for iPhone/iPad that allows you to go to wikipedia entries for the current song playing in apple music (song, artist, album). It was totally inspired by Amarok in KDE, which embeds wikipedia into itself.
